title: Concatenating successive rounds
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $a$ a state, $E$ a set of optional states, and $P$ a property of work-tape head positions. Let $\tau$ assign a natural-number duration to each configuration, and let $c$ be a configuration. Assume that the optional state corresponding to $a$ is not in $E$, and that $P$ holds at the work-tape head positions of $c$. Define $c_r$ by starting at $c$ and, $r$ times, running the machine for the duration assigned by $\tau$ to the current configuration. For every $r<n$, assume that $c_r$ is in state $a$, that its assigned duration is positive, and that running it for that duration reaches $c_{r+1}$, whose state is either $a$ or belongs to $E$; at each strictly intermediate positive time the state is neither halted nor in $E$ nor equal to $a$, and $P$ holds at every time from the start through the endpoint. Then running the machine from $c$ for the sum of these $n$ durations reaches $c_n$; at every time strictly before the endpoint its state is not in $E$, and $P$ holds at every time from the start through the endpoint.
